authoredFacts.statement: Peig keeps the Letter Office and knows who has received news from beyond the parish.
Mícheál and Róisín Connolly share the cottage west of the village.

currentLocation.description: A narrow counter, pigeonholes of folded paper, and a small turf fire. The room smells of sealing wax, turf smoke, and damp wool. Through the window the weather is clear. It is morning.

knownPlaces.description: A muddy road runs between low stone walls and a handful of whitewashed cottages. Smoke lifts from the clustered roofs. A lane leads east to the Letter Office and a rutted boreen runs west to Connolly Cottage. The clear sky hangs over the road. It is morning.
A narrow counter, pigeonholes of folded paper, and a small turf fire. The room smells of sealing wax, turf smoke, and damp wool. Through the window the weather is clear. It is morning.
A peat fire warms the single room. A scrubbed table, a spinning wheel by the hearth, and rain-dark coats by the door. Outside the weather is clear. It is morning.

recentConversation.npc_dialogue: And to you. The post is late again.
